news.title: Osimhen unlocks a new attacking ceiling
news.body: Victor Osimhen has four goals and two assists in his first two official archived matches. The player-requested rematch remains excluded.

news.title: Five goals, five different attacking connections
news.body: M4CROPHAGE defeated Demonlordslayer 5-2 as Osimhen produced two goals and two assists.

news.title: Mbappé owns the Golden Boot race
news.body: Kylian Mbappé leads Season One with 23 verified goals and 9 GVA.

news.title: Messi remains the primary creator
news.body: Lionel Messi leads the club with 19 verified assists.

news.title: Lamine changes the rhythm from the bench
news.body: Lamine Yamal and Kvaratskhelia have become a major second-half storyline, often improving attacking flow.

news.title: 4-2-1-3 reveals explosive potential
news.body: The current system is 3-1-1 with 13 goals scored and six conceded through five matches.

news.title: Dimarco remains the captain
news.body: The armband belongs to Federico Dimarco; crown icons are not used as captaincy evidence.

news.title: ElMejor rematch remains excluded
news.body: The player-requested 5-1 rematch has no match number and no statistical or storyline impact.
